Figure 3:Architecture ofWM-VLM, instantiated with our light Mixture-of-Transformers (light MoT) design. The understanding branch, comprising the vision encoder and language decoder, is initialized from a pretrained VLM. The shallow generation branch containskklayers, each paired with a corresponding layer in a consecutivekk-layer block of the understanding branch. Text and clean visual tokens are routed to the understanding branch, whereas noisy visual tokens are routed to the generation branch. All tokens interact through global self-attention.

Figure 9:Representative samples from Tetris-2D and Tetris-3D. Text denotes mental rotation actions and images denote their resulting visual states. The 2D example stores the final state after two90∘90^{\circ}rotations, while the 3D example explicitly interleaves each90∘90^{\circ}rotation with its corresponding visual state.
